<<<page display="238" pdf="238">>>
--- Pages 238–239 ---
It is 8 o'clock, and I can not be late.
I do not wish to make my pals wait.

I must be there at half past ten.
But I have lots of time until then.

<<<page display="240" pdf="240">>>
--- Pages 240–241 ---
At last I am set and on my way there,
But I think I still have some time to
spare.

I wade in this lake as frogs
hop away.
I do not think they wish to play!

<<<page display="242" pdf="242">>>
--- Pages 242–243 ---
The sun is hot, and I nap on a rock.
Then I wake up and gaze at the clock.
Drats! It is 10 o'clock. Can it be?
Will my pals still be there for me?

<<<page display="244" pdf="244">>>
--- Pages 244–245 ---
I dash up a lane and past the gate.
I am on my way, but am I late?
My six best pals sit with Miss Tate.
I tell them all why I am late.
They grin at me and then they say,
“Now we can hear the story today!”
